newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil weakens at close on Wong data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil weakens at close on Wong data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices weakened further in late trading due to a bearish crop report by forecaster Ivan Wong and lack of export business. Technical selling also emerged when Sept traded at around 1,160 while some covering stepped in at 1,150-1,153. Sept's trading range seen at 1,150-1,180.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Followed futures, with business limited by a lack of support from refiners.
Wong estimated exports in June at 595,000 tonnes against 626,606 tonnes in May.

Wong also estimated palm oil output in June at 785,000 tonnes, against the 790,640 tonnes in May. He put stocks at the end of June at 795,000 tonnes, against the 711,8541 tonnes tallied by the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority at end-May.
Traders said players also liquidated positions for fear of further losses in the near-term.
At the close, turnover rose to 1,209 lots from 275 at midday.
The September futures contract closed 13 ringgit lower at 1,154 ringgit ($457.21) a tonne. Other traded futures contracts also finished 13 ringgit down.
Lack of active demand in physicals also limited cash business, they said. Only some refiners were seen covering positions at lower levels, traders said.

Physicals saw July (south) crude palm oil saw offers at 1,200 ringgit against bids at 1,195 after trading at 1,205 to 1,197.50. July (central) saw offers at 1,190 versus 1,180 with earlier trades at 1,190 and 1,185.
Aug (south) was offered at 1,200 against bids of 1,195 with trades at 1,205 and 1,200. Aug (central) was offered at 1,192.50 against bids of 1,190.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $500 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Aug/Sept at $497.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $497.50.

July RBD palm olein saw offers at $540, Aug/Sept at $535 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $532.50. Aug/Sept was traded at $540 and $532.50, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $535 and $530. July RBD palm stearin was offered at $385 and July/Aug palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290. -- Tan Lee Lee -603- 275-6834 ($1-2.5240)
